hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Human behavior is entirely deterministic and can be accurately predicted using traditional statistical methods
testable_predictions: Small changes in initial conditions will lead to drastically different outcomes
The accuracy of predictions decreases as the complexity of human behavior increases
hypotheses.falsification_criteria: If a highly accurate predictive model of human behavior can be developed, or if small changes in initial conditions do not result in significantly different outcomes

hypotheses.null_hypothesis: The butterfly effect is a mathematical anomaly that does not apply to human behavior
testable_predictions: Certain critical thresholds of complexity or uncertainty can trigger a reversal from determinism to chaos
Small changes in initial conditions can have profound effects on complex systems
hypotheses.falsification_criteria: If the predictive power of traditional statistical methods remains high even when dealing with complex and uncertain situations, or if the butterfly effect is only observed in highly controlled laboratory settings
hypotheses.domain: Complexity Science and Philosophy of Mind
